body:
**Overall review:** [Per-repository task yield, costs, limitations and next steps](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/043dd27e/experiments/33-unattended-validation/overall-summary.md). This is the primary summary; detailed logs and HF receipts live in comments and linked research artifacts.

**Historical ten-repo survey:** 83 exports, 82 with an ever-positive control pair and 67 with an ever-clean oracle command after follow-up controls. Matchms contributes 58/58/53, Cobrapy 12/12/2, Scanpy 1/0/0, OHIF 12/12/12; six repositories produced no exports in the bounded run. Only 1,961 of 23,285 inventoried PRs entered. These are historical controls, not 67 portable/released tasks; Matchms raw redistribution is restricted and six original builds are absent.

**Unattended delivery:** draft PR #63 automates official discovery/bootstrap/generation → export → independent controls → accounting/HF readback/cleanup without Codex or added repair-model calls. Fresh NiBabel produced one clean selected-file task (9 regression tests repaired, 37 existing tests preserved). DendroPy is tracked-positive but unclean; other negative trials remain recorded. 186 local tests and both CI checks pass at c19e7369. Main is unchanged; no release.

**Cost:** history-wide #28 $6.113565 OpenRouter ($12.088851 including September); incremental #33 $2.196603 / 61 calls and 14.892111111 reserved CPUh. Combined model charges for these two issues: $14.285454, excluding earlier #24/#25. The $10 storage reserve remains unreconciled. All admitted jobs are terminal; no outstanding model/CPU reservations or active paid execution.

**Agent-owned review:** 32 research/follow-up issues reviewed; 27 completed bounded questions closed. Five substantive follow-ups remain: #29 timeout/scheduling, #32 runner/selection coverage, #56 source provenance, #60 compiled rebuilding, #64 subtest identities. These are agent-owned backlog, not individual user review requests. [Review register](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/043dd27e/experiments/33-unattended-validation/issue-review-2026-10-26.md). Review the overall summary and consolidated PR #63; no automatic merge, release or additional run.

Reviewed all 28 epic children and four predecessor follow-ups: 27 completed bounded questions closed, five substantive research items retained as agent-owned backlog. This supersedes the earlier leave-all-children-open instruction. No new execution, spending, grading change or merge. The user only needs to review the overall result.
